scenes.title: Toronto Baycrest Table: Endel Tulving & Patient K.C. Playing Tactical Chess Perfectly Beside Blank 'Yesterday (?)' & 'Tomorrow (?)' Cards

layout.description: Sunlit high-key Canadian neuropsychology room featuring a warm oak table holding a carved **wooden chessboard mid-game** (Semantic Rules: 100% Intact!), a map of Ontario where K.C. points accurately to his family's cottage, and two large white thought-frame easels beside him — **'Personal Past Episode: [Blank White Canvas]'** and **'Tomorrow Afternoon Plan: [Identical Blank White Canvas]'**.

positions.who: Endel Tulving (mannequin in tailored dark blazer and open-collar shirt)
positions.where: seated across the chessboard making a knight move, then gesturing gently between the two blank 'Yesterday' and 'Tomorrow' frame cards

positions.who: Patient K.C. / Kent Cochrane (mannequin in neat Canadian plaid flannel overshirt and chinos)
positions.where: executing a crisp, smart chess bishop counter-move effortlessly — then pausing thoughtfully with open palms before both the 'Remember One Game You Played' card and the 'Imagine Tomorrow' card

props.name: wooden Staunton chessboard & Ontario cottage map ('Semantic Knowledge: 100%')
props.period_detail: proves intact intelligence, rules, and geographic facts
props.physical_behavior: documented real-world strengths of Kent Cochrane

props.name: paired 'Relive Yesterday: Blank' & 'Imagine Tomorrow: Blank' white frame easels
props.period_detail: visualizes Tulving's stunning discovery that past reliving and future imagination vanish together

actions.verb_sequence: moves his bishop diagonally in a clever tactical pin and points accurately to the cottage spot on the Ontario map -> Tulving asks for ONE lived memory of playing chess OR what K.C. imagines doing tomorrow -> K.C. gestures calmly to both blank white frames ('The exact same kind of blankness')

reactions.reaction: notes that Episodic Memory is a bidirectional Mental Time Machine for past AND future
remains calm, polite, and articulate throughout the chess match

scenes.wardrobe: Early-2000s Toronto attire: academic dark blazer over collared shirt; neat casual flannel overshirt and chinos.
scenes.lighting: Warm, bright high-key Toronto window daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: He plays a sharp game of chess right in front of you — yet cannot remember a single game from his past OR picture a single scene of his own tomorrow!

key_visual.description: a sunlit neuropsychology table where a researcher and patient play a wooden chessboard beside an Ontario map and two blank easel frames labeled Yesterday and Tomorrow

scenes.title: 2007 fMRI Proof: Yesterday & Tomorrow Light Up the Exact Same Network!

layout.description: Clean bright neuroimaging console displaying two nearly identical glowing brain maps side-by-side: 'Remembering 3 Years Ago' vs 'Imagining 3 Years Ahead'.

positions.where: pointing to matching hippocampal + Default Mode activation across Past and Future scans

props.name: Past (-3 yr) vs Future (+3 yr) twin fMRI brain maps
props.period_detail: confirms Tulving's bedside insight across healthy brains

actions.verb_sequence: toggles between Past recall and Future simulation -> same core network stays lit

reactions.reaction: celebrates solving *why* memory stays constructive and flexible

scenes.recognition_hook: Scan a healthy brain remembering last summer and imagining next summer — the two brain maps look like identical twins!

scenes.title: Passing School Without Recess Memories (Developmental Amnesia, 1997)

layout.description: Sunny classroom desk where a bright teenager aces a world-geography map quiz (Semantic!) while needing a pocket notebook to check what happened after lunch (Episodic!).

positions.where: reviewing top factual vocabulary & geography grades built entirely via intact cortical Semantic memory

props.name: A-grade geography map + pocket daily schedule pad
props.period_detail: proves children with neonatal hippocampal injury still build rich Semantic knowledge

actions.verb_sequence: labels capitals effortlessly on map -> checks pocket pad for afternoon appointment

scenes.recognition_hook: Lose hippocampi as an infant and you can STILL master school vocabulary, math, and geography — proving encyclopedia facts don't need episodic memories to stick!
